verdict.rationale: Godot can run unattended through its documented command-line workflow and `--headless` display server, which the runtime probe says supports CI builds, exports, and scripted editor automation. That lets an external scheduler or CI system run Godot jobs in the background, but Godot itself has no built-in automation, trigger, or scheduling layer. EditorScript automations must also be started by hand from the editor (File > Run). Missing for 10: native scheduling/triggers for background automations, an agent-driven autonomous execution mode, and hands-on corroboration of unattended automation workflows.
